name: Turn off the advertising ID
description: Enables the Group Policy 'Turn off the advertising ID' (Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > System > User Profiles) by setting DisabledByGroupPolicy = 1 (REG_DWORD) in HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AdvertisingInfo. The advertising ID is turned off for every account on the device.
rationale: Apps can use the advertising ID to correlate a person's activity across apps for personalized advertising. The documented policy removes that identifier without affecting how apps work.
effects: The advertising ID is turned off; apps cannot use it for experiences across apps.
Applies to every user account on the device.
sideEffects: The advertising ID option in Settings > Privacy & security > General is managed by the policy and cannot be turned back on by users while the policy is set.
Ads shown inside apps may be less relevant.
notes: Policy definition UserProfiles.admx, policy DisableAdvertisingId (class Machine): key Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AdvertisingInfo, value DisabledByGroupPolicy, enabled value 1, disabled value 0.

Microsoft's privacy guidance additionally mentions HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo\Enabled = 0. WinLean does not set it: its semantics are not documented, while the policy alone is documented to turn the ID off.
Requires Administrator rights (the value is stored under HKLM).
